description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter called ContentRowAdapter for an Android application. The adapter renders a list of content rows, each with a title and a horizontal list of content cards. The code manages focus behavior to ensure the row title remains visible when any card inside the row gains focus by scrolling the parent RecyclerView accordingly.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that presents a list of content rows, each containing a title and a horizontal list of content cards. Handles focus navigation and ensures row titles remain visible when a child card gains focus.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for ContentRowAdapter, representing each content row view with a title and nested RecyclerView of content cards.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of ContentRow objects.

methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder instance by inflating the item_content_row layout.

methods.description: Binds data item to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: RowVH.bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow to the ViewHolder, setting the title and configuring the nested RecyclerView with focus handling to keep the title visible during focus navigation.
